|errata_history=This is the original printed state of the card, titled •Blind Jedi. The later version [[Rahm Kota, Blind Jedi]] (PC-E1, the current card) is titled •Rahm Kota, Blind Jedi with the same game text. The release-sheet slip on this page prints •Blind Jedi; the Master List slip and the Players Committee card image print •Rahm Kota, Blind Jedi (see [[Rahm Kota, Blind Jedi]]).
* '''Original''' (this page): titled “•Blind Jedi” (lore “Insurgent leader.”) on the Virtual Block 7.2 release sheet, slip 02: “[Episode I] Jedi are lost. At battlegrounds, Insurgents are immune to attrition < 5. Once per turn, may peek at top card of your Reserve Deck (or if Galen on table, any Reserve Deck); may place that card on top of owner's Used Pile. May not carry weapons.”<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock7_2">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_2.pdf Virtual Block 7.2 release sheet] ("Official text as of December 15, 2010"; PDF made 23 December 2010). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261016180935/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_2.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB7-02-Rahm_Kota_Blind_Jedi.png]]) prints it. The PC website card list still showed the card under this title from 21 July 2012 to 11 January 2013.<ref name="cl-1272_15-old">Players Committee website card list (VBlock7Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064742/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2012-07-21], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211205229/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2012-12-11] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111152155/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive; the same in the VMasterType list): “Blind Jedi”</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Rahm Kota, Blind Jedi]]): On 29 January 2013 the [[Players Committee]] announced the persona-name change “Blind Jedi ---> Rahm Kota”, effective immediately (old slips stayed tournament-legal; non-gameplay lore was removed; “Each of the cards will retain their gametext and characteristics”)<ref name="persona2013">[https://web.archive.org/web/20130221003512/http://www.starwarsccg.org/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=350&catid=1&Itemid=117 New Persona Changes], [[Players Committee]], 29 January 2013. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20130221003512/http://www.starwarsccg.org/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=350&catid=1&Itemid=117 Internet Archive].</ref>. The PC website card list shows the new title by 14 March 2013 (the last capture with the old title is of 11 January 2013)<ref name="cl-1272_15-new">Players Committee website card list (VBlock7Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20130314031820/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2013-03-14] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130516000419/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2013-05-16] (Internet Archive): “Rahm Kota, Blind Jedi” (these captures carry no game text)</ref>, and the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Light Side, p. 13) prints the card as “•Rahm Kota, Blind Jedi” (lore “Insurgent leader.”)<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>: “[Episode I] Jedi are lost. At battlegrounds, Insurgents are immune to attrition < 5. Once per turn, may peek at top card of your Reserve Deck (or if Galen on table, any Reserve Deck); may place that card on top of owner's Used Pile. May not carry weapons.” The game text did not change. The PC website card list (2012-07-21 to 2013-01-11, titled “Blind Jedi”) has “owners Used Pile” without the apostrophe (punctuation only, held for a ruling). The Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1272-15-front-master.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB7-L-rahmkotablindjedi-pre.gif]]) print it.
